meta.title: Become a Partner Driver in Dakar | Navette Xpress
meta.description: Join the Navette Xpress network. Become a partner private driver in Dakar and enjoy attractive earnings, flexible hours and 24/7 support.

hero.title: You know the road. We have the passengers.
hero.subtitle: We work with a limited number of drivers on the corridor. Regular rides, fares known before you accept, payment within seven days. Twelve spots open for 2026.
hero.imageAlt: Photo — partner driver, AIBD waiting area

payment.text: Payment delay after the ride. Bank transfer, Wave or Orange Money.

commission.text: Fixed commission, announced before your first ride. No sign-up fee.

corridor.text: You stay on the corridor you know, not sent at random across Dakar.

items.label: VOLUME
items.text: Between 12 and 20 rides per week depending on the availability you declare. The schedule goes out on Friday for the following week.

items.label: FARE
items.text: The amount of each ride is known before you accept it. No bidding, no blind rides, no fare revised after the fact.

items.label: DISPUTES
items.text: A human contact, reachable, and a written procedure in case of disagreement with a client. You're not alone facing an app.

items.label: FUEL
items.text: Tolls and fuel reimbursed at cost on long rides, on presentation of the receipt.

items.title: You introduce yourself
items.text: Identity, vehicle and availability. The form takes just a few minutes to fill in.

items.title: We call you back
items.text: Within 48 business hours. We reply to everyone, even when it's a no.

items.title: We meet
items.text: Meeting in Dakar or Mbour, checking your papers and the vehicle's condition.

items.title: First ride
items.text: A supervised ride on a short segment, then entry into the schedule.

application.title: Do the terms work for you?
application.desc: Fill in your application opposite. No documents to upload at this stage: we go over the paperwork together on the day of the meeting.

perk2.text: No application fee, at any point.

form.title: Application file

fields.insurance: I certify that I have valid insurance
fields.license: My driving license is valid (over 3 years)
fields.availabilityHint: Requests will be assigned based on the time slots you declare.

motivation.label: Your motivations
motivation.placeholder: Tell us about yourself and why you want to join us...

form.footnote: Response within 48 h · No application fee

success.title: Application received
success.desc: Thank you for your interest in Navette Xpress. Our partner team will review your application.
success.descHighlight: You will receive a response within 48 h.
